title: Majority influence factor bound
statement:
For natural numbers $m$ and $j$ with $j<m$, let $I(r)=\binom{2r}{r}/2^{2r}$ for each natural number $r$. Then
\[
\frac{\pi}{2}(2m+1)I(m-j)I(m)\leq\left(1-\frac{2j+2}{2m+1}+\frac{2j+1}{(2m+1)^2}\right)^{-1/2}.
\]
